steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Phew, the apotropaic ritual is done! But why are there monsters lurking near the Fusang tree...
Because this isn't some auspicious blessed tree, but the afterimage of a Black Ring. These are all creatures of Mania... You murmur inwardly.

The Corruptors turn out to be more numerous than you imagined, but fortunately, the FAC team cooperates flawlessly with you and Yanyan can fight too. Soon, you've wiped out all the incoming Corruptors.
After getting rid of all the Corruptors nearby, you realize you've almost made it to the Drifter Camp unknowingly. You can even catch a glimpse of that dark gate.
So the influence of the Black Ring has reached here too... You have to check on the situation inside the Drifter Camp.
Outside the Drifter Camp, a large pile of rubble has yet to be cleared. You can hear the crunching footsteps over the debris.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Umm, I didn't expect to see such a place in DisCity besides those glittering skyscrapers.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Were these stones and houses smashed by some monster? Ah! Some were even burned to ashes.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Did something bad happen here?
Yanyan carefully examines her surroundings, her eyebrows slightly furrowed.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A battle happened here. A fierce one.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Was it also because... the gods were angry?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There are no gods in DisCity. The people just keep fighting among themselves.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But this fight was not for nothing. It was a battle of survival where ordinary people united for their dreams and hopes.
Flashbacks

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hmm... Yanyan likes this kind of story! Back home, Grandma always tells Yanyan the story about the hero who shot down the Sun Crow too.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The hero protects everyone, and the people get together to help the hero. Yanyan can never get tired of such legends!
You ruffle the girl's hair, and an FAC guard comes over in time to report the scouting results.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Of course, there's another thing. We didn't find anything resembling the sky-reaching Fusang tree, but we did find some special contaminants that are still multiplying.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: And these contaminants have already affected the residents of the Drifter Camp. People often experience ringing in their ears or hear bird calls...
The girl gets pumped upon hearing this.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah... No good! If they keep hearing these sounds, how can they sleep at night!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, can we help the people there while we're on the way to look for the branch? You know, the fabled heroes never hesitated to lend a helping hand!
Yanyan stands with her arms akimbo, striking a heroic pose.
